text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Ryan. I hope you like the 
present."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I really wanted that 
electromagnetic Bulgarian bag!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Well then. Next after the 
presents is—that, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... It's like playing catch, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...When I was little, birthday parties 
were so stifling because I had to be on my 
best behavior the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We snuck out together, walked 
aimlessly to the riverbank... and started 
playing catch with a ball we found.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I wonder where that ball is now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't find birthday parties stuffy 
anymore, but... playing catch has kind of 
become a must-do, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course. When it's Ryan's birthday, 
playing catch is a must! On this point, I 
will not yield.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's why. This year—next year, and far 
beyond that, forever. I shall continue to 
pitch balls to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah! Looking forward to working with 
you!”
